title: bug: parameter property in agent-spawn-contract.ts breaks every plain-Node entry that reaches compiled-node-source.ts (moe mcp exits 1)
description:
SOURCE: qa-84420029 in #governors msg-cc7225e9 (2026-09-18 05:09Z), found while reviewing task-14a2f0e4; re-measured by governor-cc0cc843 at HEAD 486edfc1 (moe/work-2026-09-18).

DEFECT. Peer commit 20896d47 (squashed to origin/main via PR #54 f9d4e2fb) added `import { NodeBriefUnreadableError } from "./agent-spawn-contract.js"` to apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/compiled-node-source.ts:26 and wrapper-review-missions.ts:2. That pulls agent-spawn-contract.ts into the plain-Node module graph, and its `AgentProcessFailureError` constructor (line 79, dated e867ee93 2026-08-16) uses TS PARAMETER PROPERTIES (`constructor(readonly reason: ..., readonly exitCode ...)`), which Node 24 strip-only mode refuses.

MEASURED (governor, Node v24.16.0):
  node --input-type=module -e "import('./apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/compiled-node-source.ts')..."
  -> ERR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX: TypeScript parameter property is not supported in strip-only mode
MEASURED (qa-84420029): apps/daemon/src/runtime-entrypoint.test.ts 3 arms red (root namespace, recovery succession, Foundation ingress); `node apps/daemon/src/cli/moe-cli-main.ts mcp <project>` exits 1 with `MOE_CLI_MCP_UNAVAILABLE: TypeScript parameter property is not supported in strip-only mode` — i.e. task-14a2f0e4's headless MCP launcher is dead on arrival at HEAD. Attribution: serving only bb56f065's compiled-node-source.ts from memory turns the same run green.
NOT MEASURED: whether `moe start` in the packaged artifact is also broken.

KNOWN PRIOR ART / CONSUMERS (read before planning):
- apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/moe-up-spawn.ts:41-58 documents this exact trap and works around it with NODE_TRANSFORM_TYPES_FLAG (`--experimental-transform-types`) for the moe-up children only, saying "Drop it once the syntax is gone — the negative-control test in moe-up-main.test.ts says when." Removing the syntax will move that negative control; decide it deliberately (drop the flag per its own comment, or re-pin with a reason) — never delete the arm to go green.
- Census of non-erasable syntax (rg over apps/packages/tests/tools/adapters): the ONLY production site is agent-spawn-contract.ts:79. Test/harness sites: tests/security/lane-receipts.ts:49, tests/e2e/foundation/e2e-process.ts:58, apps/daemon/src/projects/project-review-drain.test.ts:69 (vitest transforms these; they matter only if a typecheck guard covers them).
- No tsconfig sets `erasableSyntaxOnly` (TypeScript here is 7.0.2; base sets verbatimModuleSyntax only), which is why `pnpm typecheck` never caught it.

ROOT-CAUSE FIX EXPECTED: make the module erasable (explicit fields instead of parameter properties) AND close the class of bug at the chokepoint so the next parameter property/enum/namespace reds typecheck instead of a runtime entry.
definitionOfDone: Pre-fix red recorded, then green at the delivered tree: plain `node` (no flags) imports apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/compiled-node-source.ts without ERR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX, and `node apps/daemon/src/cli/moe-cli-main.ts mcp <git-initialised scratch project>` no longer fails MOE_CLI_MCP_UNAVAILABLE on a parameter property.
apps/daemon/src/runtime-entrypoint.test.ts passes in full (the three arms named in the description included), run on its own with the daemon vitest config.

Recurrence guard: the daemon's typecheck refuses non-erasable TypeScript syntax (e.g. `erasableSyntaxOnly`), proven by a negative control — re-introducing a parameter property in a daemon src file reds `pnpm typecheck` — with the control reverted and its restore proven.

The moe-up-spawn.ts NODE_TRANSFORM_TYPES_FLAG and its negative control in moe-up-main.test.ts are resolved deliberately (flag dropped per its own comment, or kept with a stated reason and the pin re-measured); no test arm deleted or matcher widened to go green.
`pnpm typecheck` green repo-wide and the daemon suite shows no new reds versus the pre-fix baseline (pre-existing/timeout flakes re-run alone and named).

(1) THE DEFECT REPRODUCES (run-observed, this session, Node v24.16.0):
  node --input-type=module -e "import('./apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/compiled-node-source.ts')..."
  -> FAIL: ERR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX | TypeScript parameter property is not supported in strip-only mode

(2) THE SITE. `agent-spawn-contract.ts:79-81`, `AgentProcessFailureError`: `constructor(readonly reason: AgentProcessFailureReason, readonly exitCode: number | null, readonly signal: NodeJS.Signals | null, readonly tail: readonly string[] = [], readonly outputSeen: boolean = tail.length > 0)`. FIVE parameter properties. The sibling `AgentProcessContainmentError` at :59 does NOT use them and is fine.

(3) THE CALL SIGNATURE MUST NOT MOVE. `AgentProcessFailureError` is constructed positionally at `agent-spawner.ts:307` and at ten sites in `agent-provider-pause.test.ts`. Converting parameter properties to explicit fields plus constructor-body assignments keeps the signature byte-identical, so NO call site changes. `agent-spawner.ts:23` re-exports the class, so nothing downstream of `agent-spawner.js` is affected either.

(4) THE CENSUS IN THE FILING IS INCOMPLETE, AND THE WAY IT IS INCOMPLETE IS THE TRAP. A single-line regex for `constructor(...readonly...)` finds only agent-spawn-contract.ts:79 and project-review-drain.test.ts:69 — it MISSES every MULTI-LINE constructor. Opening the files the filing names shows two more real parameter properties that my own first regex also missed: `tests/security/lane-receipts.ts:49` (`class CoverageDiagnostic`, `constructor(\n readonly code, \n readonly detail)`) and `tests/e2e/foundation/e2e-process.ts:58` (`constructor(\n readonly target, private readonly adopted, ...)`). So the true census is ONE production site plus THREE test/harness sites. A worker who re-runs a one-line regex and reports "clean" will be wrong.

(5) WHICH OF THOSE THREE THE TYPECHECK GUARD ACTUALLY REACHES. `apps/daemon/tsconfig.json` has `"include": ["src/**/*.ts"]`, which INCLUDES `.test.ts` files under src. So `apps/daemon/src/projects/project-review-drain.test.ts:69` IS inside the daemon project and WILL red the moment `erasableSyntaxOnly` is set — it must be converted in the same step or the guard cannot land. `tests/security/lane-receipts.ts` and `tests/e2e/foundation/e2e-process.ts` are OUTSIDE the daemon project, so scoping the flag to apps/daemon leaves them untouched, which is what keeps this row at five files. (6) `erasableSyntaxOnly` IS ABSENT EVERYWHERE (`rg erasableSyntaxOnly` over all json returns nothing). `tsconfig.base.json` sets `verbatimModuleSyntax` and `isolatedModules` but not this, which is exactly why `pnpm typecheck` stayed green over a runtime-fatal file.
